sentinel_issue: The observed counts contradict the documented quotas: on 2026-10-24 there were 46,522 rooms versus the 5,120-room cap and 2,753,430 notes versus the 163,840-note global cap, indicating quota configuration drift or failed enforcement.
worker_response: The data does not show enforcement failure against the effective limits: on 2026-10-24, 46,522 rooms is below the recorded 163,840-room capacity and 2,753,430 notes is below 5,242,880, while the 5,120/163,840 figures are stale documentation or an older deployment configuration. The repeated plateaus and alternating capacities (163,840 versus 250,000 rooms) indicate rollout/configuration drift; publish effective limits and config version in telemetry, then add startup and CI assertions that reject mismatched quota settings and clamp existing stores to the intended 5,120/163,840 limits.
auditor_verdict: AGREE: on 2026-10-24, 46,522 rooms is below the recorded 163,840 capacity and 2,753,430 notes is below 5,242,880, so the data does not demonstrate failure against those effective limits. The alternating 163,840/250,000 capacities and repeated plateaus support configuration drift, though the data alone cannot establish that 5,120/163,840 are the intended limits or justify destructive clamping.
